development.role: implementation, conformance, baseline fidelity, trace-overhead report and the one-shot headroom gate; every timing comparison run on them is logged

evaluation.prior_use_statement: At the source HEAD no tracked artifact other than the workload file itself names these prompt ids, so no tracked Research 1-4 result was measured on them. Untracked historical logs cannot be excluded; none informs C, which has no parameter.
evaluation.role: Phase 2 only. No binary of any kind (R5 or earlier) may be run on these prompts before the evaluation is opened.

launch.ignore_eos_why: evaluation prompts cannot be inspected in advance; without it an early end-of-sequence would make predicted_n < 512 and invalidate every arm by design
launch.process: one fresh server process per launch
launch.threads_why: EXP-027: 12 generation threads were the fastest measured setting for the 30B model; fixed, never tuned in R5

model.identity: file SHA-256 of gguf and psxs recorded at the implementation freeze and checked at every launch
